title: Stay in the Game
hook: Some days you won't believe it's going to work. Showing up anyway is the whole job.
statement: Real persistence means staying in the game even when you don't believe you're going to win.
explainer: This isn't blind stubbornness. It's staying in while you keep learning, adjusting, and recovering. Plenty of people quit right before the odds turn. Recovery is what keeps you around long enough.
sop: Name the goal that's worth staying in for.
Separate how you feel from what the data says.
Change the strategy without dropping the mission.
Build in recovery time so you don't burn out.
Keep taking the next useful action.
equation_example: Persistence 8, Adaptation 6, Recovery 4. 8 × 6 × 4 = 192 Long-Term Success, out of 1,000. Higher means you're staying in and getting sharper. Lower, especially weak Recovery, means you'll burn out before things turn your way.
question: Write down one goal you'll keep pushing on even though you're not sure you'll win.
closing_statement: Doubt is a feeling, not a verdict.
caption:
Principle Nº 270: Stay in the Game

Real persistence means staying in the game even when you don't believe you're going to win.
